messages.subject: Legend
parts:
Hello
I have this plot. I want to change the titel of the legend, which is a bit problematic because I have both shape and color combined.

I tried labs(color="'custom text"), which works, but then I get two different legends, one for the color and one for the shape

this is part of the lines:

AW<-ggplot(dotAW, aes(x = AASW, y = WW, shape = taxa, color = taxa)) +
..       
        scale_color_manual(values =tol19rainbow [as.numeric(dotAW$color)])  +                 
        scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 15) [as.numeric(dotAW$shape)])   + theme(legend.title = element_text(size=25, face="bold"), legend.text = 
        element_text(size=15))
AW


Do you know how to solve this?
Thanks
Inga
